title: How to Fix Low Damage in Path of Exile 2
summary: The real reasons your damage is low in Path of Exile 2 - low gem level, unfilled support sockets, weak weapon DPS, wrong support gems, no crit multiplier, no quality or catalysts, empty jewel sockets - and exactly how to fix each one.
description: A troubleshooting guide for low damage in Path of Exile 2: a checklist of the factors that actually move your DPS and how to fix them.
imageAlt: Tempest Bell, a high-damage skill for fixing low damage output in Path of Exile 2
prerequisites: A character in Acts or early endgame
Access to your skill gem and passive tree screens
author: Exile2 Guides Editorial Team

items.title: Most common cause
body: Low gem level and unfilled support sockets. A level 1-5 skill gem with no supports hits a fraction of a fully supported setup. Level your main skill gem every time you can, and fill its support sockets with damage supports (default 2, up to 5 with Jeweller's Orbs).

items.title: The biggest DPS lever most players ignore
body: Weapon base DPS and the support gems linked to your skill. A flat-DPS weapon upgrade often beats a passive point, and the right support gems (more levels, added damage, penetration) multiply everything.

items.title: Cheap wins
body: Quality on gems (20% gives a real bonus), catalysts on jewels, and a single crit multiplier roll. None require rare gear but each adds up fast.

stats.label: Support sockets per skill gem
stats.note: Supports socket into the skill gem itself; Jeweller's Orbs add sockets (Lesser 3, Greater 4, Perfect 5).

stats.label: Gem quality sweet spot
stats.note: Most gems gain a scaling bonus at 20% quality

stats.label: Free passive points from resistances
stats.note: Cap resist on gear to spend points on damage

sections.title: Low-damage checklist
sections.caption: Work top to bottom. The earlier rows usually explain 80% of low-damage complaints.

cells.why: Damage scales hard with gem level
cells.fix: Equip the highest-level copy; do not run a level 1 gem

cells.why: Each support in your skill gem multiplies damage
cells.fix: Fill every support socket on your main skill gem (default 2, up to 5 via Jeweller's Orbs)
Use damage supports matching your skill tags (added dmg, crit, penetration)
Upgrade to a higher physical/elemental DPS base

cells.why: Unspent attribute points can block higher gems
cells.fix: Meet Str/Dex/Int requirements for your top gems
Add crit chance on gear; stack crit multi on jewels

cells.why: 20% quality and catalysts add free modifiers
cells.fix: Quality gems; catalyst jewels for the right stat

cells.why: Jewels add crit multi / added damage
Capping res on gear frees passive points
cells.fix: Move resistance from tree to gear, spend points on damage

sections.note: Always level your main skill gem first - it is the single highest-impact, zero-cost change.

sections.title: Crit by build type
sections.caption: Crit multiplies burst damage, but not every build wants it. Find your build type below.

cells.why: Crit multiplies every hit; most attack skills scale hard with crit
cells.action: Stack crit chance on gear; add crit multiplier on jewels

cells.why: Crit applies to spell hits (not to DoT); big burst for casters
cells.action: Crit chance on gear; crit multiplier jewels; confirm the spell can crit
Skip crit; invest in ailment magnitude and duration

cells.why: Minion hits crit only with minion crit investment; rarely a priority
cells.action: Ignore player crit; invest in minion damage

cells.why: Depends on whether the triggered hit can crit
cells.action: Verify the specific skill before investing

sections.note: If your build type says 'No' or 'Varies', spend those points and affixes on damage-over-time, penetration, or flat damage instead.

sections.title: Where to look: skill, gear, tree
sections.intro: Low damage usually lives in one of three places. Open the matching tab for the fixes.

tabs.label: Skill setup
paragraphs: Your skill gem and its links are the foundation of all damage.
bullets: Check the gem level of your main skill - if it is not near your character level, that is the problem.
Confirm your main skill gem has its support sockets filled (default 2, up to 5 with Jeweller's Orbs).
Verify support gems match the skill's tags (physical, elemental, spell, attack).

tabs.label: Gear
paragraphs: Gear supplies base damage, crit, and the attributes that let you equip bigger gems.
bullets: Compare your weapon's base DPS; a flat upgrade often beats a passive point.
Add crit chance and crit multiplier where your build uses crit.
Quality gems to 20% and catalyst jewels for the stat you need.

tabs.label: Passive tree
paragraphs: The tree should amplify, not compensate for, a weak setup.
bullets: Cap resistances on gear so you can spend tree points on damage nodes.
Fill empty jewel sockets with crit-multi or attribute jewels.
Path through damage notables that connect to your skill tags.

sections.title: Why is my damage low?
sections.intro: Select the situation that matches you. The tool lists the most likely cause.

rules.title: Check gem level and links first
steps: Level your main skill gem to your character level.
Confirm your main skill gem's support sockets are all filled.
Upgrade your weapon base DPS - it scales most skills directly.

rules.title: You lack single-target setup
steps: Bosses resist the clear-speed setup; add a single-target skill or support.
Check penetration and crit multiplier - bosses have higher effective HP.
Use a jewel or support that boosts boss damage specifically.

rules.title: Your clear setup is weak
steps: Add area-of-effect or projectile-count supports for packs.
Verify your skill hits multiple enemies (pierce, chain, or AoE).
Check that added-damage supports apply to your damage type.

rules.title: Attribute or socket break
steps: A gear swap may have dropped an attribute below a gem's requirement, disabling it.
Re-check that your skill gem still holds its support gems after swapping gear.
Re-catalyst jewels if the new gear changed your needed stats.

defaultResult.title: Systematic damage audit
steps: Level the main gem, fill its support sockets, upgrade weapon DPS, add crit multiplier, quality gems, and fill jewel sockets.
Cap resistances on gear to free passive points for damage.
If still low, compare your setup against a known build guide for your class.

items.question: Is gem level really that important?
answer: Yes. Damage scales steeply with gem level, so a level 1-5 main skill gem does a small fraction of a max-level one. Level it every time you level up.

items.question: Do I need a fully supported skill gem to do damage?
answer: Not strictly, but each support gem in your skill's sockets multiplies your damage. Filling all support sockets (up to 5 with Jeweller's Orbs) is the single biggest DPS jump for most builds.

items.question: Why cap resistances on gear instead of the tree?
answer: Resistance on the passive tree spends points you could use for damage. Moving resistances onto gear frees those points for damage nodes.
